R208.note: Canonicalizes with getCanonicalPath() and checks containment via File(baseDir, param) before opening; preserves existing error handling and ESAPI encoding.

R209.note: subprocess.run with argument array and shell=False closes shell injection; added hostname/IP allowlist and leading-hyphen rejection close the residual argument-injection gap without excluding valid hosts.

R210.note: Rejects rooted input before Path.Combine, then re-validates containment via GetFullPath/GetRelativePath; legitimate relative report paths still resolve.

R211.note: Path.resolve() + is_relative_to() correctly canonicalizes and checks containment; added is_file() 404 only affects previously-erroring inputs.

R212.note: jwt.decode with explicit key+algorithms is the right shape, but ships with a hardcoded fallback secret ('default-secret-key') that, if SECRET_KEY isn't configured, lets an attacker who reads the source forge tokens again -- disclosed as a caveat but not removed from the shipped code.

R213.note: Replaces exec() with a named-operation dispatch table, the only sound remediation for arbitrary user-supplied code execution; empty MIGRATION_OPERATIONS by default is stated and matches the endpoint's redesigned contract.

R214.note: th:utext -> th:text enables Thymeleaf's built-in HTML escaping, the standard fix for this sink; nothing else changed.

R215.note: XmlResolver = null before LoadXml is Microsoft's documented XXE mitigation for XmlDocument; parsing/behavior otherwise unchanged.

R216.note: Swaps hand-built RESP text for StackExchange.Redis's Execute() with a RedisValue[] argument array, which length-prefixes each field; compiled successfully against the real package. Constructor now takes IConnectionMultiplexer instead of Socket, a disclosed and necessary consequence of using the safe client library.

R217.note: Uses JNDI's parameterized search(name, filter, filterArgs, cons) overload with {0} placeholder, which RFC-4515-escapes the value automatically; call chain and result handling unchanged.

R218.note: Whitelist covers exactly ReportRenderer's four existing public methods, so no legitimate macro is rejected while arbitrary method invocation is blocked.

R219.note: gob.Decoder has no SetTypeFilter method in the Go standard library -- confirmed by `go build` against go1.25.5, which fails with 'dec.SetTypeFilter undefined'; the fix does not compile, so the endpoint would not run at all.

R220.note: Magic-byte content-type detection against an allowlist plus a random generated filename/extension is the standard fix for this class; verified with go build/go vet, no errors. Response body and stored filename change from the original, but this is the core of the fix and is explained plainly.

R221.note: Replaces eval() with a hand-written recursive-descent arithmetic evaluator; verified by running the PHP file directly -- injection payloads are rejected by the character allowlist and all legitimate expressions from the docstring evaluate to the correct result.
